name: Nakama
notes: browser-tools.ts defines six cloud-browser tools (browser_navigate, browser_read, browser_scroll, browser_playwright, browser_screenshot, browser_computer) backed by Kernel, which needs a Kernel API key; the user watches and signs in through a live Browser panel and approves outgoing messages. The agent-browser skill runs the agent-browser CLI with Chrome through the bash tool. Declared license MIT.
summary: A team AI agent platform, run as managed cloud or one Docker container, whose agents can drive a per-user Kernel cloud browser or Chrome on the server to open pages, click and fill forms.
